title: Effects of silver doping at the A-site on the structure, surface morphology, and magnetic behavior of La1−xAgxSrMn2O5+δ (x = 0.1 and 0.2)
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,22616-22628
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02729B, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Sonia Soltani, Mokhtar Hjiri, Abdullah M. Aldukhayel, Manel Essid, Anouar Jbeli, Nouf Ahmed Althumairi
This study explores the impact of silver substitution at the A-site on the structural, morphological, and magnetic properties of La1−xAgxSrMn2O5+δ compounds, specifically for doping levels x = 0.1 and 0.2.
